product_overview: FisioFlow 2026 is a digital clinic platform for private physiotherapy practices in São Paulo, combining authentication, operational dashboards, patient management, scheduling, financial oversight, and AI-assisted clinical workflows. The product is designed to help clinicians and managers work faster across patient care, appointments, and treatment administration.
core_goals: Sign in to the clinic system and access the main workspace
View clinic performance metrics and upcoming operational items
Search, filter, and review patient records
Manage appointments through the clinic schedule
Review financial metrics and invoice-related information

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allows users to access the clinic platform through the authentication page before entering the main system.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit sign-in form -> See the main dashboard
Navigate to /auth -> Continue in guest mode -> Access the application workspace

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Shows the clinic’s main operational snapshot, including key metrics and upcoming appointments.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review clinic metrics -> Open metric cards -> View detailed metric information -> Review the daily appointments list

features.name: Patient Directory
features.description: Lets staff search, filter, and open patient records from the patient list.
user_flows: Navigate to /patients -> Search for a patient by name -> Review the filtered results -> Select a patient row -> Open patient details
Navigate to /patients -> Filter patients by status -> Review the updated patient list -> Select a patient row -> Open patient details

features.name: Appointment Schedule
features.description: Provides a scheduling view for managing clinic appointments and attendance.
user_flows: Navigate to /schedule -> Review the appointment calendar -> Inspect scheduled appointments -> Update attendance status -> See the schedule reflect the change

features.name: Exercise Library
features.description: Provides access to the physiotherapy exercise library for browsing available exercises.
user_flows: Navigate to /exercises -> Browse the exercise library -> Open an exercise entry -> Review exercise details

features.name: Financial Management
features.description: Shows financial metrics and invoice management information for the clinic.
user_flows: Navigate to /financial -> Review financial metrics -> Inspect invoice information -> Review invoice status details
